doc.brief: The QGraphicsDropShadowEffect class provides a drop shadow effect.

QColor color() const.brief: This property holds the color of the drop shadow.

QPointF offset() const.brief: This property holds the shadow offset in pixels.

qreal blurRadius() const.brief: This property holds the blur radius in pixels of the drop shadow.

qreal xOffset() const.brief: This property holds the horizontal shadow offset in pixels.

qreal yOffset() const.brief: This property holds the vertical shadow offset in pixels.

void blurRadiusChanged(qreal blurRadius).brief: This signal is emitted whenever the effect's blur radius changes.

void colorChanged(const QColor &color).brief: This signal is emitted whenever the effect's color changes.

void offsetChanged(const QPointF &offset.brief: This signal is emitted whenever the effect's shadow offset changes.

void setBlurRadius(qreal blurRadius).brief: This property holds the blur radius in pixels of the drop shadow.

void setColor(const QColor &color).brief: This property holds the color of the drop shadow.

void setOffset(const QPointF &ofs).brief: This property holds the shadow offset in pixels.

void setOffset(qreal d).brief: This property holds the shadow offset in pixels.

void setOffset(qreal dx, qreal dy).brief: This property holds the shadow offset in pixels.

void setXOffset(qreal dx).brief: This property holds the horizontal shadow offset in pixels.

void setYOffset(qreal dy).brief: This property holds the vertical shadow offset in pixels.

blurRadius.brief: The blur radius in pixels of the drop shadow

color.brief: The color of the drop shadow

xOffset.brief: The horizontal shadow offset in pixels

yOffset.brief: The vertical shadow offset in pixels
